schema.purpose: SI-R2.1 (T-1a) RED vectors of the official BVE target contract. SEMANTIC vectors: a step says WHAT the host reports (state / index) and WHAT the application must then hold and show; it never says how the wire looks (tests/official_target_wire_fixture.py converts, E-10 provisional).
schema.source_values: source=observed:<id> marks values copied from the SI-DIAG canon (E1-D 570.00->570.04 index 3->3; E2-D retest 570.00->570.00 index 3->2; start-station F5 d=0.00 index 0->1; terminal T kept across F5). Station geometry of the lists and every distance other than those is SYNTHETIC (source=synthetic): not an observation.
schema.hud_literals: hud_dist / hud_time_left are the texts the REAL draw_hud renders; the oracle self-check feeds the expected target (BVE-owned step) or the machine values (TS-owned step) to the REAL HUD and requires the same literal, so a hand-computing mistake is a FIXTURE FAIL.
schema.owner: owner=BVE: the official target is shown (scoring off or finished); owner=TS: the scoring target (the machine target the C# state machine holds) is shown. Rule: target_owner_is_scoring = is_scoring_mode and not is_scoring_finished.
schema.d7: D-7 (OD-X2): start station is host-faithful, no d=0 exception, F5 re-acquires the official target, BVE5/BVE6 differences are not compensated (no version field exists in any vector).
